script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet of sensual earth sign Taurus, is locked in a potent conjunction with the Sun in your 3rd House of Communication, while action-oriented Mars in your 6th House of Daily Work forms a flowing trine to transformational Pluto in your 10th House of Career, supercharging your public ambitions. The earth element keeps these sparks grounded in reality. If you are single, this Venus-Sun blend magnifies your magnetism through witty texts and neighborhood encounters; if taken, a sibling or short trip revives passionate dialogue with your partner. In money matters, the Mars-Pluto trine across your 10th House signals a sudden promotion or lucrative contract if you assert authority before noon. Avoid signing leases under emotional pressure—the blessing arriving is an unexpected check from a distant client. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
